description: This is an HTML source file implementing a web-based database viewer interface, including styles and client-side scripting for dynamic data fetching and interaction.

methods.name: loadDatabases
methods.description: Fetches and loads list of databases into the sidebar.

methods.name: refreshDatabases
methods.description: Refreshes the list of databases and resets the interface.

methods.name: toggleDatabase
methods.description: Expands or collapses a database's table list.

methods.name: loadTables
methods.description: Loads the tables within the selected database.

methods.name: loadTableData
methods.description: Loads data for the selected table.

methods.name: renderTable
methods.description: Renders data in a table format.

methods.name: renderCell
methods.description: Renders individual cell content, handling objects and long text.

methods.name: expandCell
methods.description: Expands or collapses cell content for better visibility.
